preparationStatus: Prepared declaration only; it is not evidence of a Play Console submission, review, acceptance, or publication.

specificUserActionException.description: A freshly redacted output can be handed to an Android share-sheet destination only after the user explicitly chooses Share and chooses that destination. This user-initiated handoff is the specific-user-action exception; it is not background or app-controlled sharing.

dataEncryptedInTransit.reason: The app does not collect or transmit user data itself, so no encryption-in-transit answer applies.

dataSafety.appAccess: All functionality is available without an account, credentials, or other special access.

consoleVerification: A named human must reconcile these answers with the final binary, permissions, dependencies, and Play Console screens before submission. Any mismatch is a hold.
